<!-- pr-reviewer: c92a1cb2e67f3d00d5bdd97dcd44ac362b1ae4a5 -->
Needs changes before merge.

The trial merge with upstream/main (31f8d03d744e77ce707282d816e11efe0922f239) is clean. The image command, page links, alt text, and image limits passed the local checks. I inspected all 13 committed images.

Local results:

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --dry-run`: passed; six steps planned. This was a plan check, not a gate run.
- `cargo test -p xtask`: 140 unit tests and 10 integration tests passed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --no-run`: passed on retry. The first build ended with exit 143 without a compiler error.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib`, from `crates/ui`: 849 passed; seven ignored.
- The explicit off-screen guide render test: one passed; all 13 PNGs were written to `/tmp`.
- `python3 -m unittest discover -s site/tests -p test_guide_images.py`: three passed, including the Zola build and image URL check.
- `cargo clippy -p xtask -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/guide_projects.rs:230` and `:241`: correct or explain the unsafe multi-axis examples. The committed `Indexed Face1` path has 30 gouge warnings (`examples/guide-multiaxis.camproj:6464`). `Swarf1` has 897 shank-hit, nine rapid-in-stock, and two sweep-hit warnings (`examples/guide-multiaxis.camproj:38238`). The guide embeds these paths as operation examples at `site/content/guide/multi-axis/indexed.md:70` and `site/content/guide/multi-axis/operations-multiaxis.md:162`, without an explanation of the unsafe state. The Swarf image shows red paths. Adjust the demo geometry or settings to remove these safety warnings, regenerate the images, and add assertions that reject these warnings in normal examples. If these are intended to show unsafe paths, clearly identify them as unsafe examples and explain the warnings and required corrections beside each image.

Safety checks and notes:

- The new geometry is demo geometry. The PR does not change the production post, collision, gouge, or stock simulation algorithms. No NC, CL, or release snapshot goldens moved.
- I repeated two reported mutations on temporary source copies. With `MIN_WIDTH` changed from 1000 to 1, the narrow-image test failed. With the alt-word check changed from `<= 4` to `== 999_999`, the short-alt test failed. All three unit tests passed on the unchanged copy. The review worktree source was not changed.
- The generated demo project values match the committed values except for the project format version, which current main updates from 61 to 62.
- The `crates/ui` changes add test modules only. They do not change the production UI layout.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
